_description: Cursor IDE + CLI version support matrix for the MeowKit cursor bundle's native hooks. IDE and CLI use INDEPENDENT, incompatible version schemes (verified 2026-07-24): the IDE reports semver (e.g. 3.13.10); the CLI (cursor-agent) reports calendar versioning (e.g. 2026.07.23). This matrix never collapses the two into one scalar gate — doctor-cursor.ts reads the `ide` row for its version-gate check and does not attempt to compare the CLI row against it.

ide.operationalFloorNote: Matches CURSOR_MIN_SUPPORTED_VERSION in src/migrate/providers/cursor/capabilities.ts. Every hook event this bundle targets is documented on the CURRENT (undated, 3.11-era) hooks reference page, so the floor is evidence-of-presence at 3.11, not a per-event intro-version claim.
ide.verifiedAgainstIde: 3.13.10 (this machine's installed IDE, Phase 2 live probe)
ide.perEventIntroVersionNote: UNRESOLVED for sessionStart/sessionEnd, beforeReadFile, beforeShellExecution/afterShellExecution, beforeMCPExecution/afterMCPExecution, afterFileEdit, subagentStop, preCompact, Tab hooks, workspaceOpen — the docs page does not annotate per-hook intro versions and a full changelog crawl (15+ entries) was out of scope for the Phase-4 docs pass. `stop`, `beforeSubmitPrompt`, `preToolUse`/`postToolUse` are confirmed introduced at v2.4 (2026-01-22); cloud-agent support for `beforeSubmitPrompt`/`afterAgentResponse`/`afterAgentThought`/`stop`/`subagentStart` confirmed at v3.11 (2026-07-10). Below the 3.11 floor, gate evidence is 'the event exists on the current docs page', not a verified per-version introduction date.

cli.note: cursor-agent uses calendar versioning (e.g. 2026.07.23), NOT comparable to the IDE's semver floor. No CLI-specific hook-support floor is set in this phase — the bundle targets IDE/Agent-window hook execution; CLI hook parity is unverified (docs-report gap: IDE-vs-CLI behavioral differences beyond output format and Tab-hooks-are-IDE-only are not enumerated). Do not gate on this row until CLI hook support is independently confirmed.
cli.verifiedAgainstCli: 2026.07.23-e383d2b (this machine's installed CLI, Phase 2 live probe)

hookEvents.note: Never blocking; no session boundary in cloud agents.
Matcher-enumerated: file-mutation(true), read-only-query(false), unclassified-other(true, decides ask).
Capture side-effect only; block-only contract, never exercised to block; noncritical.
Bounded status persisted to telemetry; noncritical.
Best-effort telemetry only; memory commits never depend on it.
Bounded followup_message; finite loop_limit set in hooks.json.
